Subject: Redwood keynote package — package + logo placement options

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the quick call yesterday. Per our discussion attached is the DevSummit Sponsor Package v3. We have the keynote sponsor slot open on Day 2 (45 minutes) and a hero logo on the main stage scrim (Tier A placement).

Couple of notes from our side:
- Standard package includes a 45-minute keynote + 10x10 demo pod + 5 conference passes.
- Tier A logo placement is centered on the main stage scrim (10% of width). Tier B (secondary) sits on the lower band and headliner page.
- We can trade a speaking minute allocation for an on-stage panel seat if you prefer panel format.
- Standard contract terms include a 30-day payment net and a standard indemnity clause — we can send an amendment for any specific legal asks.

If you want to request a slightly larger logo (we sometimes do a one-time swap between Tier A and a 12% width for headline partners), let me know and I can check approval with the production team.

Attached: DevSummit_Sponsor_Package_v3.pdf
DocuSign draft will be ready after we confirm scope.

Best,
Elena

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood keynote package — package + logo placement options

Hi Elena — appreciate the package and the rundown. A few clarifying items from our side before we go to signature: 

1) Logo placement: we like the Tier A position but requesting a one-time swap to the 12% width for higher visibility on stage scrim. If production signs off, we'd accept the swap in exchange for the panel seat rather than the full 45-minute solo keynote.

2) Speaking: instead of a solo 45-minute keynote, we propose a 30-minute keynote followed by a 30-minute moderated panel that features our Head of Inference and a customer. That reduces keynote time but increases panel exposure. Is that acceptable?

3) Deliverables: please confirm that we get the 10x10 demo pod, five full conference passes plus two speaker expo-only passes, and one pre-event webinar slot (30 minutes) included in the final scope. If pre-event webinar isn't included by default, we'd like to add it as part of the amended scope.

4) Commercials: you mentioned a one-time logo swap for a visibility uplift. Please confirm the delta in sponsorship fee for that swap and any incremental AV costs. Also confirm payment terms — we prefer net 45 for marketing budgets; if that's not possible, we can do net 30 with a small PO in advance.

I've attached a quick redlines checklist that covers the above and a copy of our brand master file to speed art approval.

Next steps: if you can confirm the logo swap and panel/keynote mix by EOD Tuesday, we can route to legal and procurement and complete a DocuSign by Friday.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Head of Events, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_sponsor_redlines_v1.docx

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear list. Good news: production has provisionally approved the 12% stage scrim swap in exchange for converting the keynote into a 30-minute keynote + 30-minute moderated panel (we'll set the moderator and provide stage mics).

On deliverables: the demo pod, five full passes, and two speaker expo-only passes are in scope; the pre-event webinar is not included in the standard keynote package but we can add a 30-minute pre-event webinar for a $6k add-on.
